D.tier: Queued, roster and office levers only

D.t: Gil Cisneros leads by 27.7 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 71,037 votes; a one point swing is about 1,282 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +20.5 and D +35.0. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
$230K cash against $14K. Spend it early on persuasion television in the battleground counties and keep a reserve for the last week.
